Plot Imprintome Polar Coordinates

Source: R/module_plotting.R
PlotPolar.Rd

Plot Imprintome Polar Coordinates

Usage

PlotPolar(
  data,
  outFile = NULL,
  colorColumn = "Sample_Group",
  title = "ImprintomeR:Polar",
  subtitle = NULL,
  palette = "default",
  alpha = 0.8,
  legend.position = "auto",
  legend.nrow = NULL,
  legend.ncol = NULL,
  legend.page = "auto",
  legend.page.threshold = 16,
  legend.text.size = 8,
  control_groups = "auto",
  label_width = 30
)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing Angle and IDS plus grouping columns.

outFile

Optional output file path.

colorColumn

Column name used for point fill grouping.

title

Plot title.

subtitle

Optional plot subtitle.

palette

Palette name passed to GetColors().

alpha

Point alpha.

legend.position

Legend position. Use "auto" to place small legends at the bottom and large legends on a separate PDF page when exporting.

legend.nrow

Number of legend rows for bottom legends. NULL uses an automatic value based on the number of groups.

legend.ncol

Number of legend columns for separate legend pages. NULL uses an automatic value based on the number of groups.

legend.page

Logical or "auto"; when saving a PDF, write crowded legends to a second legend-only page.

legend.page.threshold

Number of groups above which "auto" uses a separate legend page for PDF export.

legend.text.size

Legend text size.

control_groups

Groups drawn in a fixed grey and on top of the other points. "auto" (default) uses groups whose name contains "control" or "normal" (case-insensitive); NULL for none.

label_width

Legend labels longer than this many characters are wrapped.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Colours are assigned to the sorted group names, so a group keeps its colour across plots of the same cohort. Larger groups are drawn first so that small groups stay visible. The radial axis extends beyond 0.8 when a sample's IDS is larger.
